in_sanskrit.name: Divu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Gift, Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Divu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Divu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Divya' which means 'Divine, Graceful, or Gift from God'. In Tamil and Telugu, it is also used to refer to the Goddess Diva, who is associated with light, knowledge, and love. Divu is a beautiful name for a baby girl, signifying the blessings and grace bestowed upon her by the gods.

in_hindi.name: दिवु
in_hindi.meaning: दिवस (day) + वुः ( ending suffix, meaning deep or ocean)
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is deep like the ocean or as deep as a day.

in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is deep like the ocean or as deep as the earth.
